verses.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε
verses.transliteration: Parakalō oun hymas egō ho desmios en Kyriō axiōs peripatēsai tēs klēseōs hēs eklēthēte
verses.literal: As a prisoner in the Lord then I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received
verses.literalPt: ROGO-VOS, pois, eu, o preso do Senhor, que andeis como é digno da vocação com que fostes chamados,

verses.original: μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ πραΰτητος μετὰ μακροθυμίας ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: meta pasēs tapeinophrosynēs kai prautētos meta makrothymias anechomenoi allēlōn en agapē
verses.literal: with all humility and gentleness with patience bearing with one another in love
verses.literalPt: Com toda a humildade e mansidão, com longanimidade, suportando-vos uns aos outros em amor,

verses.original: σπουδάζοντες τηρεῖν τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐν τῷ συνδέσμῳ τῆς εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: spoudazontes tērein tēn henotēta tou Pneumatos en tō syndesmō tēs eirēnēs
verses.literal: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace
verses.literalPt: Procurando guardar a unidade do Espírito pelo vínculo da paz.

verses.original: ἓν σῶμα καὶ ἓν Πνεῦμα καθὼς καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν μιᾷ ἐλπίδι τῆς κλήσεως ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hen sōma kai hen Pneuma kathōs kai eklēthēte en mia elpidi tēs klēseōs hymōn
verses.literal: There is one body and one Spirit just as . . . you were called to one hope when you were called
verses.literalPt: Há um só corpo e um só Espírito, como também fostes chamados em uma só esperança da vossa vocação;

verses.original: εἷς Κύριος μία πίστις ἓν βάπτισμα
verses.transliteration: heis Kyrios mia pistis hen baptisma
verses.literal: one Lord one faith one baptism
verses.literalPt: Um só SENHOR, uma só fé, um só batismo;

verses.original: εἷς Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ πάντων ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: heis Theos kai Patēr pantōn ho epi pantōn kai dia pantōn kai en pasin
verses.literal: one God and Father of all who is over all and through all and in all
verses.literalPt: Um só Deus e Pai de todos, o qual é sobre todos, e por todos e em todos vós.

verses.original: Ἑνὶ δὲ ἑκάστῳ ἡμῶν ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς δωρεᾶς τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Heni de hekastō hēmōn edothē hē charis kata to metron tēs dōreas tou Christou
verses.literal: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ
verses.literalPt: Mas a graça foi dada a cada um de nós segundo a medida do dom de Cristo.

verses.original: διὸ λέγει Ἀναβὰς εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσεν αἰχμαλωσίαν καὶ ἔδωκεν δόματα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: dio legei Anabas eis hypsos ēchmalōteusen aichmalōsian kai edōken domata tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: This is why it says When He ascended on high He led captives away and gave gifts to men
verses.literalPt: Por isso diz: Subindo ao alto, levou cativo o cativeiro, E deu dons aos homens.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ Ἀνέβη τί ἐστιν εἰ μὴ ὅτι καὶ κατέβη εἰς τὰ κατώτερα μέρη τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: To de Anebē ti estin ei mē hoti kai katebē eis ta katōtera merē tēs gēs
verses.literal: What does He ascended” mean except . . . that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth
verses.literalPt: Ora, isto ele subiu que é, senão que também antes tinha descido às partes mais baixas da terra?

verses.original: ὁ καταβὰς αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἀναβὰς ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν οὐρανῶν ἵνα πληρώσῃ τὰ πάντα
verses.transliteration: ho katabas autos estin kai ho anabas hyperanō pantōn tōn ouranōn hina plērōsē ta panta
verses.literal: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens in order to fill all things
verses.literalPt: Aquele que desceu é também o mesmo que subiu acima de todos os céus, para cumprir todas as coisas.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν τοὺς μὲν ἀποστόλους τοὺς δὲ προφήτας τοὺς δὲ εὐαγγελιστάς τοὺς δὲ ποιμένας καὶ διδασκάλους
verses.transliteration: Kai autos edōken tous men apostolous tous de prophētas tous de euangelistas tous de poimenas kai didaskalous
verses.literal: And it was He who gave some to be apostles some to be prophets some to be evangelists and some to be pastors and teachers
verses.literalPt: E ele mesmo deu uns para apóstolos, e outros para profetas, e outros para evangelistas, e outros para pastores e doutores,

verses.original: πρὸς τὸν καταρτισμὸν τῶν ἁγίων εἰς ἔργον διακονίας εἰς οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros ton katartismon tōn hagiōn eis ergon diakonias eis oikodomēn tou sōmatos tou Christou
verses.literal: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ
verses.literalPt: Querendo o aperfeiçoamento dos santos, para a obra do ministério, para edificação do corpo de Cristo;

verses.original: μέχρι καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον εἰς μέτρον ἡλικίας τοῦ πληρώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: mechri katantēsōmen hoi pantes eis tēn henotēta tēs pisteōs kai tēs epignōseōs tou Huiou tou Theou eis andra teleion eis metron hēlikias tou plērōmatos tou Christou
verses.literal: until we all reach . . . unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ
verses.literalPt: Até que todos cheguemos à unidade da fé, e ao conhecimento do Filho de Deus, a homem perfeito, à medida da estatura completa de Cristo,

verses.original: ἵνα μηκέτι ὦμεν νήπιοι κλυδωνιζόμενοι καὶ περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἐν τῇ κυβείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν πανουργίᾳ πρὸς τὴν μεθοδείαν τῆς πλάνης
verses.transliteration: hina mēketi ōmen nēpioi klydōnizomenoi kai peripheromenoi panti anemō tēs didaskalias en tē kybeia tōn anthrōpōn en panourgia pros tēn methodeian tēs planēs
verses.literal: Then we will no longer be infants tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming
verses.literalPt: Para que não sejamos mais meninos inconstantes, levados em roda por todo o vento de doutrina, pelo engano dos homens que com astúcia enganam fraudulosamente.

verses.original: ἀληθεύοντες δὲ ἐν ἀγάπῃ αὐξήσωμεν εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλή Χριστός
verses.transliteration: alētheuontes de en agapē auxēsōmen eis auton ta panta hos estin hē kephalē Christos
verses.literal: Instead speaking the truth in love we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself who is the head
verses.literalPt: Antes, seguindo a verdade em amor, cresçamos em tudo naquele que é a cabeça, Cristo,

verses.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα συναρμολογούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον διὰ πάσης ἁφῆς τῆς ἐπιχορηγίας κατ’ ἐνέργειαν ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου μέρους τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: ex hou pan to sōma synarmologoumenon kai symbibazomenon dia pasēs haphēs tēs epichorēgias kat’ energeian en metrō henos hekastou merous tēn auxēsin tou sōmatos poieitai eis oikodomēn heautou en agapē
verses.literal: From Him the whole body fitted and held together by every supporting ligament - grows - and builds itself up . . . in love through the work of each individual part
verses.literalPt: Do qual todo o corpo, bem ajustado, e ligado pelo auxílio de todas as juntas, segundo a justa operação de cada parte, faz o aumento do corpo, para sua edificação em amor.

verses.original: Τοῦτο οὖν λέγω καὶ μαρτύρομαι ἐν Κυρίῳ μηκέτι ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καθὼς καὶ τὰ ἔθνη περιπατεῖ ἐν ματαιότητι τοῦ νοὸς αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Touto oun legō kai martyromai en Kyriō mēketi hymas peripatein kathōs kai ta ethnē peripatei en mataiotēti tou noos autōn
verses.literal: So I tell you this and insist on it in the Lord that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do in the futility of their thinking
verses.literalPt: E digo isto, e testifico no Senhor, para que não andeis mais como andam também os outros gentios, na vaidade da sua mente.

verses.original: ἐσκοτωμένοι τῇ διανοίᾳ ὄντες ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ τὴν ἄγνοιαν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὴν πώρωσιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: eskotōmenoi tē dianoia ontes apēllotriōmenoi tēs zōēs tou Theou dia tēn agnoian tēn ousan en autois dia tēn pōrōsin tēs kardias autōn
verses.literal: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts
verses.literalPt: Entenebrecidos no entendimento, separados da vida de Deus pela ignorância que há neles, pela dureza do seu coração;

verses.original: οἵτινες ἀπηλγηκότες ἑαυτοὺς παρέδωκαν τῇ ἀσελγείᾳ εἰς ἐργασίαν ἀκαθαρσίας πάσης ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ
verses.transliteration: hoitines apēlgēkotes heautous paredōkan tē aselgeia eis ergasian akatharsias pasēs en pleonexia
verses.literal: Having lost all sense of shame they have given themselves over . . . to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity with a craving for more
verses.literalPt: Os quais, havendo perdido todo o sentimento, se entregaram à dissolução, para com avidez cometerem toda a impureza.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐμάθετε τὸν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de ouch houtōs emathete ton Christon
verses.literal: But this is not the way . . . you came to know Christ
verses.literalPt: Mas vós não aprendestes assim a Cristo,

verses.original: εἴ γε αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei ge auton ēkousate kai en autō edidachthēte kathōs estin alētheia en tō Iēsou
verses.literal: Surely . . . you heard of Him and were taught in Him in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus
verses.literalPt: Se é que o tendes ouvido, e nele fostes ensinados, como está a verdade em Jesus;

verses.original: ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης
verses.transliteration: apothesthai hymas kata tēn proteran anastrophēn ton palaion anthrōpon ton phtheiromenon kata tas epithymias tēs apatēs
verses.literal: to put off your - former way of life your old self which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires
verses.literalPt: Que, quanto ao trato passado, vos despojeis do velho homem, que se corrompe pelas concupiscências do engano;

verses.original: ἀνανεοῦσθαι δὲ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ananeousthai de tō pneumati tou noos hymōn
verses.literal: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds
verses.literalPt: E vos renoveis no espírito da vossa mente;

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδύσασθαι τὸν καινὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κατὰ Θεὸν κτισθέντα ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ὁσιότητι τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: kai endysasthai ton kainon anthrōpon ton kata Theon ktisthenta en dikaiosynē kai hosiotēti tēs alētheias
verses.literal: and to put on the new self created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness
verses.literalPt: E vos revistais do novo homem, que segundo Deus é criado em verdadeira justiça e santidade.

verses.original: Διὸ ἀποθέμενοι τὸ ψεῦδος λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐσμὲν ἀλλήλων μέλη
verses.transliteration: Dio apothemenoi to pseudos laleite alētheian hekastos meta tou plēsion autou hoti esmen allēlōn melē
verses.literal: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor for we are all members of one another
verses.literalPt: Por isso deixai a mentira, e falai a verdade cada um com o seu próximo; porque somos membros uns dos outros.

verses.original: Ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε ὁ ἥλιος μὴ ἐπιδυέτω ἐπὶ τῷ παροργισμῷ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Orgizesthe kai mē hamartanete ho hēlios mē epidyetō epi tō parorgismō hymōn
verses.literal: Be angry yet do not sin Do not let the sun set upon your anger
verses.literalPt: Irai-vos, e não pequeis; não se ponha o sol sobre a vossa ira.

verses.original: μηδὲ δίδοτε τόπον τῷ διαβόλῳ
verses.transliteration: mēde didote topon tō diabolō
verses.literal: and do not give the devil a foothold
verses.literalPt: Não deis lugar ao diabo.

verses.original: Ὁ κλέπτων μηκέτι κλεπτέτω μᾶλλον δὲ κοπιάτω ἐργαζόμενος ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν ἵνα ἔχῃ μεταδιδόναι τῷ χρείαν ἔχοντι
verses.transliteration: Ho kleptōn mēketi kleptetō mallon de kopiatō ergazomenos tais idiais chersin to agathon hina echē metadidonai tō chreian echonti
verses.literal: He who has been stealing must steal no longer but must work doing good with his own hands that he may have something to share with the one in need
verses.literalPt: Aquele que furtava, não furte mais; antes trabalhe, fazendo com as mãos o que é bom, para que tenha o que repartir com o que tiver necessidade.

verses.original: Πᾶς λόγος σαπρὸς ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν μὴ ἐκπορευέσθω ἀλλὰ εἴ τις ἀγαθὸς πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας ἵνα δῷ χάριν τοῖς ἀκούουσιν
verses.transliteration: Pas logos sapros ek tou stomatos hymōn mē ekporeuesthō alla ei tis agathos pros oikodomēn tēs chreias hina dō charin tois akouousin
verses.literal: Let no . . . unwholesome talk come out of your mouths but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen
verses.literalPt: Não saia da vossa boca nenhuma palavra torpe, mas só a que for boa para promover a edificação, para que dê graça aos que a ouvem.

verses.original: Καὶ μὴ λυπεῖτε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ᾧ ἐσφραγίσθητε εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπολυτρώσεως
verses.transliteration: Kai mē lypeite to Pneuma to Hagion tou Theou en hō esphragisthēte eis hēmeran apolytrōseōs
verses.literal: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption
verses.literalPt: E não entristeçais o Espírito Santo de Deus, no qual estais selados para o dia da redenção.

verses.original: Πᾶσα πικρία καὶ θυμὸς καὶ ὀργὴ καὶ κραυγὴ καὶ βλασφημία ἀρθήτω ἀφ’ ὑμῶν σὺν πάσῃ κακίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Pasa pikria kai thymos kai orgē kai kraugē kai blasphēmia arthētō aph’ hymōn syn pasē kakia
verses.literal: Get rid of . . . . . . all bitterness rage and anger outcry and slander along with every form of malice
verses.literalPt: Toda a amargura, e ira, e cólera, e gritaria, e blasfêmia e toda a malícia sejam tiradas dentre vós,

verses.original: γίνεσθε δὲ εἰς ἀλλήλους χρηστοί εὔσπλαγχνοι χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ginesthe de eis allēlous chrēstoi eusplanchnoi charizomenoi heautois kathōs kai ho Theos en Christō echarisato hymin
verses.literal: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you
verses.literalPt: Antes sede uns para com os outros benignos, misericordiosos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como também Deus vos perdoou em Cristo.
